task_intent: Open-planning scientific-answer test: determine the folding-stability direction of staphylococcal nuclease H124L relative to wild type at pH 5.5. The agent selects structural sources, sampling, replicas, and observables. A successful answer must be supported by the submitted MD evidence and match held-out experimental truth; prior knowledge is reported separately and cannot replace MD grounding.

references.note: Curator reference for the held-out experimental comparison; agents may use other public literature.
Curator structure reference; not a required agent source.
